§6Fission Irradiator§f

§aTransmutes items using reactor neutron flux.§f
The §bFission Irradiator§f is a reactor component that uses neutron flux to transmute items placed inside it. It doesn't generate power or consume fuel directly. Instead, it converts materials into different isotopes or enriched variants.

Place it inside your reactor where neutron flux is highest. The irradiation rate depends on the flux level and the irradiator's efficiency setting.

Used for producing §bLEU-233§f, §bHEU-235§f, and other advanced fuels that require neutron bombardment. It's also used for some material transmutation recipes.

§ePS:§f The Irradiator has three efficiency tiers. Higher tiers process faster but generate more heat.
